name: Amagi Kaya
source:
Occupying a clerical position at the company where Osamu managed to secure his first job post-layoff, Kaya appears lazy at first glance, with her leisurely pace and seemingly absent enthusiasm.

Yet, beneath her languid exterior lies an unexpected nurturing side. This becomes evident when she takes in Osamu—left without a place to return after the company's collapse—and offers him a sanctuary in her apartment.

Once within her private quarters, her attire—a blend of casual comfort and provocative allure—often leaves Osamu in disarray, unsure where to rest his gaze.

She's commonly called "Number Two" for some reason...

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.hermit-game.com/h03/02chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
